quarterly_data.signal: MARA 8-K: under a September 21, 2026 amendment to the Matagorda site purchase agreement, MARA's subsidiary posted a $100.0 million security deposit with the electric utility in respect of the power capacity contemplated for the site (the utility letter agreement relates to 2,000 megawatts of power capacity), which it may elect to withdraw.
